channel.title: Lalo y la Playa Musical - Free Printables
channel.description: Free bilingual coloring pages for toddlers and preschoolers. Print Spanish + English pages with Lalo the baby manatee and sing along with his songs on YouTube.

item.title: Beach Ball Fun Free Coloring Page - ¡A jugar con la pelota!
item.description: Free printable beach ball fun coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡A jugar con la pelota!. Lalo the baby manatee plays catch with a friend on the beach. A sweet way to talk about sharing and taking turns.

item.title: Sunscreen Time Free Coloring Page - ¡Protector solar!
item.description: Free printable sunscreen time coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡Protector solar!. Sun-safety coloring page: Lalo gets ready for a beach day with sunscreen. Great before summer trips and pool days.

item.title: Sandcastle Crabs Free Coloring Page - Cangrejitos en el castillo
item.description: Free printable sandcastle crabs coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. Cangrejitos en el castillo. Three little crabs hide in the sandcastle. Pair it with Lalo's peekaboo song for toddlers.

item.title: Brush Your Teeth Free Coloring Page - ¡A cepillarse los dientes!
item.description: Free printable brush your teeth coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡A cepillarse los dientes!. Tooth-brushing coloring page for toddlers. Use it to build a happy morning and bedtime routine.

item.title: Recycle with Pita Free Coloring Page - ¡A reciclar con Pita!
item.description: Free printable recycle with pita coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡A reciclar con Pita!. Pita and Lalo keep the beach clean. A simple first lesson about recycling and caring for nature.

item.title: Boo-Boo Care Free Coloring Page - Ay, mi aletita
item.description: Free printable boo-boo care coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. Ay, mi aletita. Lalo hurts his flipper and Abuela Tortuga helps. A gentle page about boo-boos, comfort and feeling better.

item.title: Wash Your Hands Free Coloring Page - ¡A lavarse las manos!
item.description: Free printable wash your hands coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡A lavarse las manos!. Hand-washing coloring page with soap and bubbles. Perfect for preschool hygiene lessons.

item.title: Say Thank You Free Coloring Page - ¡Gracias, Abuela!
item.description: Free printable say thank you coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¡Gracias, Abuela!. Lalo says thank you to Abuela Tortuga. Practice the magic words: por favor y gracias.

item.title: Feelings Faces Free Coloring Page - ¿Cómo te sientes?
item.description: Free printable feelings faces coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. ¿Cómo te sientes?. Happy, sad, mad or scared? Color the feelings faces and name each emotion in Spanish and English.

item.title: Bedtime Lullaby Free Coloring Page - Canción de cuna
item.description: Free printable bedtime lullaby coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5. Canción de cuna. A calm bedtime coloring page with Lalo under the moon. A quiet activity before sleep.
